hero.title: Launch {{brandName}} without rebuilding the boring parts
hero.subtitle: Accounts, teams, billing, file uploads and an admin panel are already built and tested. Spend your time on the feature your customers pay for.
hero.stack: FastAPI, React 19, PostgreSQL and Tailwind CSS. Open source under the MIT license.

preview.windowLabel: Preview of the app your customers see after signing in

features.title: Everything around your product, ready on day one
features.subtitle: Pick a part of the kit to see where it lives in the app your customers sign in to.

auth.title: Authentication
auth.description: Email and password, Google login, email verification, password reset and secure refresh tokens.

organizations.title: Organizations and teams
organizations.description: Workspaces with owner, admin and member roles, invitations by email or link, and an organization switcher.

billing.title: Subscriptions
billing.description: Plans, trials and limits with Stripe, Lemon Squeezy or Creem. Switch providers with one environment variable.

dashboard.title: Dashboard and charts
dashboard.description: An overview with usage stats and charts that your customers see as soon as they sign in.

files.title: File uploads
files.description: Uploads to S3-compatible storage with per-plan storage limits, avatars and organization logos.

admin.title: Admin panel
admin.description: Users, organizations, MRR and trial metrics, plan overrides, impersonation and a setup checklist.

modules.title: Example module
modules.description: A complete projects module to copy when you add your own features, from database to page.

theming.title: Branding and themes
theming.description: Your name, logo and colours in one place, light and dark themes, and every string ready for translation.

steps.title: From zero to a working product in an afternoon
steps.subtitle: No boilerplate to assemble. Deploy the template, make it yours, then build the part only you can build.

deploy.title: Deploy the template
deploy.description: Runsite creates the web service, a PostgreSQL database, file storage and email, and fills in every environment variable.

brand.title: Make it yours
brand.description: Set your product name, logo and colours. Add a payment provider key when you're ready to charge.

build.title: Build your feature
build.description: Copy the example projects module, rename it, and replace it with the thing your customers pay for.

pricing.title: Simple pricing
pricing.subtitle: Start free. Upgrade when your team grows.

faq.title: Questions people ask before they start

whatIsIncluded.question: What do I get on the free plan?
whatIsIncluded.answer: Up to 3 team members, 3 projects and 100 MB of file storage. No credit card required.

trial.question: Is there a free trial of the paid plan?
trial.answer: Yes. The Pro plan starts with a 14-day trial, and you can cancel at any time before it ends.

cancel.question: Can I cancel any time?
cancel.answer: Yes. Cancel from the billing page and you keep access until the end of the paid period.

dataSafety.question: What happens to my data if I downgrade?
dataSafety.answer: Nothing is deleted. You only stop creating new items above the limits of your plan.

team.question: Can I invite my team?
team.answer: Yes. Invite people by email or share an invite link, and choose whether they join as admins or members.

cta.title: Your product, minus the plumbing
cta.subtitle: Create an account and see the dashboard your customers will use.
